_doc: Named source -> registry source id (spec v1.8 10g.5; registry valid_sources). A tagged source span binds to every alias it contains or overlaps ("Garmin Connect", "Polar watch", "venu" tokenised as "ven" + "u"); a span with no known alias, a not_ingested brand, or two different sources cannot be planned (handoff). When the source head predicts no source, the one named alias in the sentence of the read binds (common_words only where tagged).
_common_words_doc: Aliases that are also everyday words. When the source head predicts no source, a named alias binds only if the tagger marks it as a source; the others bind from the text alone (spec v1.8 10g.5, 10f device names).
_not_ingested_doc: Brands and apps Vita does not ingest (spec v1.8 10g.5). Naming one leaves a source that cannot be bound -> handoff (unbound_source), also when the tagger does not mark it.
